• উক্ত বাক্যটি  3rd Conditional Sentence.
- 3rd Conditional = If + Past Perfect (had +V3) + Perfect Modal (S + would have/could have/might have + V3)
- বা would have/ could have/ might have + V3 বাক্যের শুরুতে থাকলে if যুক্ত clause এর structure - if + past perfect + verb এর past participle form.

• একটি Conditional sentence এ দুটি অংশ থাকে।
1. Condition বা শর্ত 2. Consequence বা ফলাফল।এ ধরনের বাক্যগুলোর সাধারণ structure হলো:
• Zero Conditional = If + Present + Present (shows scientific and general truth)
• 1st Conditional = If + Present + Future
• 2nd Conditional = If + Past Simple + Future in Past (S + would/might/could + Base Form of the Verb)
• 3rd Conditional = If + Past Perfect (had +V3) + Perfect Modal (S + would have/could have/might have + V3)

• Veracious (adjective):
English Meaning: Precisely accurate; habitually speaking the truth.
Bangla Meaning: সত্য; যথার্থ; সত্যপরায়ণ; সত্যসন্ধ; সত্যনিষ্ঠ; সত্যবাদী।
Synonyms: Exact (যথাযথ), Literal (আক্ষরিক), Faithful (বিশ্বস্ত), Honest (সৎ), Truthful (সত্যপরায়ণ; সত্যবাদী)।
Antonyms: Untrue (অসত্য), Dishonest (অসৎ), Improper (অনুপযুক্ত), Fraudulent (প্রতারণামূলক), Mendacious (দুষ্টু, মিথ্যাবাদী)।

Other Forms: 
Veraciously (adverb) সত্যনিষ্ঠভাবে। 
Veracity (noun) সত্য; সত্যপরায়ণতা; সত্যসন্ধতা; সত্যনিষ্ঠা। 
Example Sentence:
1. We are the more pleased to have its authenticity vouched for by this veracious witness.
2. It is such a rarity to discover an album that is held together by songs of veracious beauty.
